summary: Frontend regression pass for FitFlow after app.json adaptive-icon backgroundColor change (#2E4BA0). Verified end-to-end first-launch flow, Home features, theme swap and home-appearance toggle. All 7 requested test areas PASS with no runtime/red-screen errors. Console shows only benign react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents/collapsable/TouchableMixin/onResponder*) coming from RN-Web internals, not app code.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Expected on web preview; native features (pedometer, notifications) won't fire here as noted in the request. Reference: /app/frontend/app/permissions.tsx

action_items: No functional fixes required. Optional cleanup: The following non-blocking RN-Web console warnings surfaced during testing (all from react-native-web internals, not the app's own code): 'shadow*' style props deprecated -> use boxShadow; 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated -> use style.pointerEvents; 'Received false for non-boolean attribute collapsable'; TouchableMixin deprecated -> use Pressable; and Unknown event handler onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponder* (bundled with RN 0.81.5 + react-native-web 0.21.0). Safe to ignore for release.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json adaptive-icon backgroundColor is now #2E4BA0 (blue). expo-notifications color is still #FF7A00 (orange) — cosmetic mismatch on Android notification icon tint vs the new brand color; consider aligning if the brand baseline changed.
